sloka: मत्पुरीमप्रधृष्यां वा ऽ ऽगमने किं प्रयोजनम् ।आयोधने वा किं कार्यं त्वया कपे ।। ५.५०.६।।।।
transliteration: matpurīmapradhṛṣyāṁ vā ' 'gamane kiṁ prayojanam ।āyodhane vā kiṁ kāryaṁ tvayā kape ।। 5.50.6।।।।

translations.english: "Enquire why this wicked one entered this inviolable city and for what purpose did he wage a war"
